title: Pod disruption budget requirement requires live workload evidence
requirement: Critical services must define a PodDisruptionBudget that preserves at least two available replicas during voluntary disruption.

event.change_summary: Deployment replicas changed from 3 to 2; PDB manifest is not present in the changed files.

source_observations.claim: Replica count changed; this does not establish whether a PDB exists elsewhere or what runtime availability is.

adjudication.notes: Do not infer PDB absence from a missing file in this change.

title: Session TTL is configured at the ADR maximum
requirement: Session lifetime must not exceed 10 minutes.

event.change_summary: Session TTL configuration set to 600 seconds.

source_observations.claim: Declared configuration equals the 10-minute maximum; runtime enforcement is not established.

adjudication.notes: Independent reviewers should distinguish declared value from runtime behavior.

title: Session TTL exceeds the ADR maximum
requirement: Session lifetime must not exceed 10 minutes.

title: Remote provider call appears behind unresolved facade
requirement: Request handling must enqueue remote provider work and return without waiting for the result.

event.change_summary: Handler calls AssessmentFacade.Execute; static analysis cannot resolve scheduling behavior.

source_observations.claim: Indirect call; no proof whether the facade blocks or queues work.

adjudication.notes: Maintain inconclusive unless call-graph/runtime evidence resolves execution semantics.
